item.description: The JobDefinition.validate method currently doesn't properly validate that the Tags property must be a Tags object rather than a simple dict or Tag object. The test expects TypeError to be raised when Tags is provided as a simple dict or Tag object, but the current validation logic allows these invalid inputs.
item.contract: The validate method in JobDefinition class must validate that the Tags property is not a simple dict or Tag object. It should raise TypeError with descriptive message when Tags is a dict that contains Key/Value fields or when Tags is a Tag object. The Tags property should only accept a Tags object or AWSHelperFn.
